english.title: Alter / deface record to prevent disclosure of information by public authority to legitimate applicant
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being

(A)_[a public authority,]_
(B)_[a person employed by a public authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..),]_
(C)_[an officer of a public authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..),]_
(D)_[subject to the direction of a public authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..),]_

(E)_[altered]_
(F)_[defaced]_
(G)_[blocked]_
(H)_[erased]_
(I)_[destroyed]_
(J)_[concealed]_

a record, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RECORD..), held by the authority, with the intention of preventing the disclosure by it of all or a part of the information to which **(..SPECIFY APPLICANT'S NAME..), the applicant of a request for information under section 77(1) of the Freedom of Information Act 2000, would have been entitled under section 1 of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 77(1) and (3) of the Freedom of Information Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
where a request had been made to a public authority and,
under section 1 of the Freedom of Information Act 2000
the applicant would have been entitled to communication of information in accordance with that section,
altered or defaced or blocked or erased or destroyed or concealed a record held by the public authority
with the intention of preventing the disclosure by that authority of information to the communication
of which the applicant would have been entitled

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Reference to section 7 of the Data Protection Act was removed from section 77 of this Act on 25th May 2018 and therefore removed from this offence. For offences prior to this date, please see document H15069.
